correctness.rationale: Exact joint moments follow by choosing disjoint vertex blocks and correcting double-counted forbidden cross edges. Factorial ratios have explicit uniform n^-2 expansions; cancellation yields abc[S(lambda-1)^2-1], with first derivative convergence and two positive simple zeros. Standalone exhaustive n=6 exact enumeration (32768 graphs, 15 exact identity checks) plus 40 high-precision and 12 sign checks replayed successfully. Experiments do not substitute for asymptotic proof.

evidence: The exact formula is a mixed third central moment, equivalently a third joint cumulant or third derivative of a multivariate log-moment generating function. The 1993 paper §12 treats numbers of cyclic-excess classes at G(n,m) criticality, not the family-indexed G(n,p) cumulant profile.

value.rationale: Triplet connected-component counts are natural multivariate observables of random graph clustering. Their mixed third cumulant exhibits a genuinely non-monotone topology-independent two-sign-reversal profile around the fundamental sparse phase scale, with both sharp locations depending only on the total component orders. It captures dependence not visible in pair covariances, not a one-off enumeration or mere numerical refinement.
